q16_lifer_receipt.title: Lifer's Receipt
q16_lifer_receipt._comment: RV. C6 clue. Trigger min_day 25 + lifer standing > 60.

show.text: A Lifer unfolds a receipt: prior sentence, Lull, 40 units, paid.

read.label: Read it aloud
read.text: Forty units. The room does the arithmetic.

keep.label: Keep it quiet
keep.text: You fold it into your file. It weighs more than paper.
